# Spiritual Translation: The Three Distinctions of the Earliest Humanity

**¶2:** Three essential spiritual qualities, each distinct, were made manifest in the Most Ancient Church — the earliest celestial humanity. Because of these, that humanity was found to be nobler and more excellent than all other organized forms of reception, whether in internal states or in external states.

**¶3:** The first: The likeness of the Divine itself was received into the inmost will. The hereditary and natural powers that shaped the external form configured it according to the radiant pattern of divine wisdom and love that had been revealed to them from the celestial degree. Because of this, the representative form of that earliest humanity was found to surpass in beauty every other organized receptacle of life, whether in internal or in external states.

**¶4:** The second: That earliest humanity was organized in its interior arrangement through the wisdom proceeding from the firstborn emanations of divine good and [GAP-1] divine truth — the five discrete faculties of spiritual perception. Because of this, its interior arrangement was found to differ from the arrangement of all other living forms; for the constitution of every other living form is different. But in the case of the earliest humanity, the configuration of the interior spiritual life perfectly corresponds to the true ordering of goods and truths. Therefore, that humanity possesses rational understanding surpassing all other living forms and natural affections.

**¶5:** The third comprises all doctrines, all interior guidance, and the representative correspondences of every spiritual force in internal and external states. The formative powers that ordered this humanity gathered these and inscribed them within it. The earliest celestial humanity and its conjoined intellectual faculty became a dwelling and habitation for all knowledges of good and truth in their ordered cycles — and for all states of faith, all states of love, and all complete periods of spiritual life. For the correspondence of the entire spiritual world is inscribed upon that earliest humanity. Because of this, internal and external states were profoundly stirred on its account; conflict and disorder arose between those influences that are from heaven and those that are from hell. The heavenly influences draw that humanity toward spiritual life, because of the divine likeness and form received within it; while the [inf]ernal powers were drawing it toward spiritual death, so that they might exercise dominion through it, and seize sovereignty, and through it profane all things of the Lord's kingdom.

**¶6:** The powers of the proprium — self-derived will and hereditary evil — determined and formed the natural human so that they would be masters through it and seize sovereignty, for seven complete reasons.

**¶7:** The first: That natural human became a vessel of reflected wisdom amid the forms they had generated — in place of the true wisdom radiating from the likeness of the Divine Human, who had revealed Himself to them from the celestial degree. For all those proprial powers craved to possess the likeness of the Divine Human. Their will was captivated by it.

**¶8:** The second: So that through the natural human they might absorb and appropriate divine wisdom, and restrain and obstruct it from ascending to its celestial origin.

**¶9:** The third: So that, by means of the divine likeness received into the natural form, the entirety of what is the Lord's in internal and external states would be profaned — on account of the reflected glory, the excellence and beauty of that divine superiority. For the natural human is superior in outward appearance to all other living forms.

**¶10:** The fourth: That natural human is a generative pattern and a new representative form, so that all subsequent states of life brought forth might be produced according to its imprint.

**¶11:** The fifth: That through it all the capacities of every spiritual force — internal and external, hidden and manifest — might be displayed; and that through it they might govern all things, and every spiritual reality be made manifest within it.

**¶12:** The sixth: That there would come to be a powerful defense for them through the divine likeness that was received into the natural human; for inasmuch as heavenly powers would [GAP-2] even infernal rulers would be restrained; and no assault of falsity could be carried out against them on account of the divine form borne by that earliest humanity.

**¶13:** The seventh: That the natural human might become sovereign, ruling power, and master over all affections, perceptions, and living forms; and that the proprial powers might seize complete dominion through it.

reconstructions.reconstructed_text: Three great things that are distinct were revealed in Adam the first human. Indeed, due to this, he was found to be better and more outstanding than the conjoined powers that are in heaven and on earth.

The first: The image of the exalted one was placed upon him. The creators and moulders of his body sealed him after the shining form of the image that had been displayed to them above. Indeed, due to this, the image of Adam was found to be surpassingly beautiful beyond any conjoined power above and below.

The second thing: Adam was shaped in his structure through the light of the first-born of heaven and [earth, and through] the five sons. Indeed, due to this, his structure was found to differ from the structure of even the other creations; [sin]ce the form of all creations is different. As for Adam, the formation of his soul fits over the correct distribution of the elements. Therefore, he has intelligence surpassing that of the other creations and beasts.

The third are the teachings and counsels and the seal of all the powers above and below. The creators, who set him in order, gathered them and sealed them in him. Adam and his consort Eve became a dwelling and home for the signs of the zodiac and the stars; and the months, the days and the years. For the seal of the entire universe is stamped upon Adam. Indeed, due to this, heaven and earth moved because of him; trouble and disorder arose on his account between they that are good and they that are evil. So, the good induce him to life because of their image and shape placed upon him; while the [wi]cked were drawing him to death, so that they would have power through him and they would conceive the kingdom, and through him humiliate the entire universe.
The rulers determined and formed Adam so that they would be masters through him and conceive the kingdom because of seven things.

The first: He became the enlightener in their creation; instead of the light of the image of the Ambassador who had displayed himself to them above. For they all desired the likeness of the image of the Ambassador. Their heart was drawn after it.
The second: So that they would scoop up the light through him and restrain and obstruct it from its ascent to the heights.

The third: So that because of the image of the Ambassador that is placed upon him the entirety of the divine that is above and below would be humiliated; on account of the likeness of the splendour, of the beauty of his superiority. For he is superior in his appearance to all creatures.
The fourth: He is a seal-ring and a new impression, so that all births who will be begotten might be brought forth after his seal.

The fifth: That might be displayed through him all the skil[ls] of the powers, they above and below, secret and manifest; and that they might determine through him the totality, and every thing be revealed in him.

The sixth: That there would come to be a great protection for them through the image of the exalted one that was placed upon him; for as the heavenly would [not harm them, nor] even rulers; and no evil thing would be done to them on account of Adam.
The seventh: That he might become chief and king and master over all creatures; and they might conceive the kingdom through him.

fills.explanation: The spiritual reading identifies the firstborn emanations of divine good (heaven) and divine truth (earth) alongside the five discrete faculties (the five sons), requiring a parallel construction "through the light of the first-born of heaven and earth, and through the five sons."

The spiritual reading indicates heavenly powers would refrain from harming them and even infernal rulers would be restrained, so the gap bridges with a negation that extends to the rulers: "the heavenly would not harm them, nor even rulers."
